# ButtonShape

`Flare.Components.ButtonShape`

Corner shape of a button, orthogonal to its variant. Every value resolves to per-theme shape tokens, so a shape looks native in whichever theme is active.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Default` | `0` | The theme's own button shape, with no override. The default - keeps each theme's native button identity. |
| `Rounded` | `1` | Rounded rectangle using the theme shape scale. |
| `Circular` | `2` | Fully rounded (pill) corners - a circle for an icon-only button. |
| `Square` | `3` | Sharp, non-rounded corners (zero radius). |

## Used by components

- `FlareButton`
- `FlareFileUploadButton`
- `FlareIconButton`
- `FlareToggleButton`
